workingPapers.title: Energy Transition, Green Growth, and Public Attention
workingPapers.abstract: Literature review, data assembly, and measurement design for a study of energy transition, green growth, and public attention. Estimation has not yet begun.

workingPapers.title: Inventory Buffers under Firm-Level Operating and Input-Cost Shocks
workingPapers.abstract: Building a firm-level panel to study how inventory buffers respond to operating conditions and input-cost shocks. Current work focuses on exposure measurement, placebo design, and model specification.
